items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I discovered his playing through Hampton Hawes records

ctx.x: Well he was quite a pioneer of a sorts on the bass, and his work, did it affect your own playing?

Well yeah. I mean I discovered his playing through Hampton Hawes records and Ornette Coleman records and of course the Bill Evans stuff, not to mention a bunch of others. But I thought, wow, that’s a different approach and I really like that. And then I found out my close connection with him, and I was sort of shocked. I mean here I am going to high school, trying to learn how to wail on the bass, and then finding out that this pioneer cat, I’m walking the same hallowed halls and this kind of thing. I used to…
Plus he probably wasn’t carrying a bass down the street.
